0.Name: Dark Room
0.Description: You're in a dark cave. It is pitch black but you begin to feel your way around the room
0.ExploreText: To the north of the room you find a key hole.

1.Name: Lake of Dreams
1.Description: You walk into a dimly lit cavern. In the center is a glowing blue lake. On the wall there is a lit Torch.

2.Name: Abandoned Forge
2.Description: You walk into a new room. It appears to be an old forge with old will forging equipment and an anvil. There is a thin beam of light coming into the room from a man made hole in the ceiling. In the corner there is a barrel of coal.

3.Name: Crossroads
3.Description: you find yourself at a crossroads in the mountains. There are three paths infront of you. One leads west down into a dark sprawlling forest. Another track to the east winds up high into the mountains. The last path leads down to a small hamlet far bellow you.

4.Name: Atvust
4.Description: you enter the village of Avust. As you walk down the narrow but clean streets the sounds of merriment begin to surround you. Soon you come to the main square to the west there is a tavern and to the east there is a market. In the gutter you see a bag of coins glinting in the sunlight.

5.Name: Mountaintop
5.Description: As you crest the peak of the icy mountain the land stretches out far below you. Below you, a village can be seen in the distance as well as a dark sprawling forrest. There is a magical presence here. Behind a pebble you can see a scroll sticking out

6.Name: Forest Entrance
6.Description: You are unerved by the forrest as if the is an evil presense here. Suddenly a bear jumps out infront of you blocking the way.

7.Name: Market
7.Description: The small market you are now presented with is surprisingly lively. All around you villagers are haggling with merchants from the outer dales. Sitting quietly at one of the stands at the far end of the market is a wizard. There is a sword for sale at one of the stalls

8.Name: Tavern
8.Description: The smell of hearty ale wafts towards you as you enter the Tavern. Once you are inside you see many people of the town including several Arcinthian Dwarves drinking and sining merrily. Behind the bar you see the Landlord cleaning an tankard.
